name: Siegfried
source:
"The more time we spend together, the more we will come to understand one another."

An inhabitant of "The End" and the oldest of the inhabitants.
One of the players of the game It is participating in. He carries a bit of a sorrowful atmosphere.
His motto is "time spent together will lead to love."

Intelligent and rational, he is a calm person.
Although his human emotions have faded, he is not cruel.
